summary: Ground-level lookout station in Plumas County; a 1924 newspaper item already calls it a lookout station; FFLA lists it gone; no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: The FFLA California list marks the site gone. The peakbagging table labels it an LO site, meaning the building was removed or its status is unknown.

events.note: Feather River Bulletin item (September 11, 1924) names the Table Mountain lookout station and a Saturday outing there
Feather River Bulletin item (June 25, 1931) says a lookout on Table Rock was abandoned when the Pilot Peak station was established; the name differs, so the link to this site is not confirmed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1931 item names the abandoned lookout Table Rock, not Table Mountain. The story cites it only as an item that may or may not concern this site, and does not use it for the site's fate.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date, designer, staffing history beyond the 1924 mention, or current description was found. The NHLR Pilot Peak page (nhlr.org/lookouts/us/ca/pilot-peak-lookout/) says the first Pilot Peak cabin was built in 1916 and rebuilt by the CCC in 1935; that does not sit easily with a 1931 'station established' item, and it was not used in the story. The Plumas County lookouts blog (plumaslookouts.blogspot.com) has a Table Mountain heading but no text in the cache. No photo found.
